action_instruction: Waiting briefly after inspecting the available-flights results table and all five rows
intent: PRIMARY: wait briefly after inspecting the available-flights results table and all five listed flight rows
rationale: The required headers and five row-level Choose This Flight actions are confirmed.

action_instruction: Checking the flight results table headers
intent: whether the results table displays the required flight result column headers in order

action_params.condition: A results table is shown with the headers "Choose", "Flight #", "Airline", "Departs: São Paolo", "Arrives: New York", and "Price".
action_params.query: whether the results table displays the required flight result column headers in order
action_params.code_js: (() => { const headers = Array.from(el(4).querySelectorAll('th')).map(h => h.textContent.trim()); const expected = ['Choose','Flight #','Airline','Departs: São Paolo','Arrives: New York','Price']; return expected.every((v,i) => headers[i] === v) && headers.length === expected.length; })()
locators: internal:text="Choose Flight # Airline Departs: São Paolo Arrives: New York Price Choose This"i

action_instruction: Checking flight selection actions in each results row
intent: whether every listed flight result row exposes a Choose This Flight action

action_params.condition: Each listed row exposes a "Choose This Flight" action.
action_params.query: whether every listed flight result row exposes a Choose This Flight action
action_params.code_js: (() => { const rows = Array.from(el(4).querySelectorAll('tr')).filter(r => r.querySelectorAll('td').length > 0); return rows.length > 0 && rows.every(r => Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('button,input[type="submit"],input[type="button"]')).some(a => (a.textContent || a.value || '').trim() === 'Choose This Flight')); })()
locators: internal:text="Choose Flight # Airline Departs: São Paolo Arrives: New York Price Choose This"i

assertion_tree.description: a results table is shown with the headers "Choose", "Flight #", "Airline", "Departs: São Paolo", "Arrives: New York", and "Price", and each listed row exposes a "Choose This Flight" action

sub_results.description: A results table is shown with the headers "Choose", "Flight #", "Airline", "Departs: São Paolo", "Arrives: New York", and "Price".
Each listed row exposes a "Choose This Flight" action.
